author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: সঠিক punctuation ও capital letter দিয়ে বাক্যটি আবার লেখো (Board: punctuation, 0.5×14)।

items.original: karim said i shall go to school
a: Karim said, "I shall go to school."
items.rule_bn: উক্তির আগে কমা, inverted comma, ভেতরে capital ও full stop।

items.original: hurrah we have won the game
a: Hurrah! We have won the game.

items.original: she reads in class nine and her brother in class six
a: She reads in class nine, and her brother in class six.
items.rule_bn: দুটি clause যুক্ত করতে কমা + and।

items.original: we should read write and speak english
a: We should read, write and speak English.

items.original: eid is a great festival of the muslims
a: Eid is a great festival of the Muslims.
